items.description: Internal frost-burst fitting repair incl. thermal-imaging leak detection
items.rationale: Frost fracture of an internal fitting is covered under 2.4.4/7.1.9 (escape of water), and leak location is covered under 2.4.6/5.2.2 (cap EUR 2,500). This is a combined covered line priced at a moderate market rate for fitting renewal, thermal imaging and one attendance.

items.description: Exterior facade frost damage repair (re-plaster and repaint)
items.rationale: The plaster failed from outdoor cold acting from without, i.e. frost on an external surface. That is the optional peril 2.1(d), and nothing indicates it was agreed, so 2.6.4 and 3.5 exclude the whole combined line. There is also no link to the internal escape.
